workflows.name: PostgreSQL Read-Replica Lag & Split-Brain Mitigation
workflows.intent: Isolate lagging follower db-replica-03 and route read traffic to healthy secondary replica read-replica-01.

drainGraceSec.description: Time allocated to finish in-flight read queries before detaching follower replica.

failoverTarget.description: Target secondary replica to receive read traffic redirect.

workflows.name: Suspicious Egress Volume & Token Quarantine
workflows.intent: Quarantine compromised worker pod, revoke leaked Autovault token, and shift egress traffic to verified mesh gateway.

quarantineNamespace.description: Cluster namespace where compromised pod is executing.

cascadeTokenRevocation.description: Whether to invalidate all downstream API tokens minted by this token.

workflows.name: Ingress OOM Recovery & Dynamic Autoscaling
workflows.intent: Patch Traefik memory allocation ceiling (+1.5 GiB) and scale deployment replicas from 4 to 12.

targetReplicas.description: Horizontal pod scale target for load rebalancing.

memoryLimit.description: Memory ceiling string per pod container resource spec.

workflows.name: Canary Rollout & Automated Checkpoint Rollback
workflows.intent: Drain canary gateway traffic, verify baseline cluster health, and trigger deterministic rollback to stable release v2.4.0.

targetReleaseVersion.description: Known stable image tag or semantic version for rollback.

workflows.name: AST Diff Code Review & TLA+ Deadlock Proof
workflows.intent: Run deterministic AST parsing, invoke TLC model checker on ACRCompositionSafety.tla, and record review consensus.

tlaWorkers.description: Number of parallel threads for TLC state space exploration.

workflows.name: SAIF Compliance & WASI Fuel Budget Audit
workflows.intent: Audit WASI runtime fuel consumption, clamp container capability bitmask, and emit tamper-evident SOC2 audit proof.

complianceFramework.description: Regulatory compliance framework for emitted audit proofs.

workflows.name: BFT Multi-Agent Deliberation & 67% Quorum Gate
workflows.intent: Facilitate adversarial deliberation between Claude, GPT, and Gemini agents, capture signed ballots, and enforce 2/3 BFT supermajority.

quorumThreshold.description: Supermajority fraction required to pass proposal.

workflows.name: Twinseal Passkey Dual-Consent Approval Gate
workflows.intent: Issue cryptographic consent challenge, park execution runner in fail-closed state, and verify dual WebAuthn signatures.

challengeTtlSec.description: Time window during which human commanders must complete passkey gesture.

workflows.name: Durable WAL Recovery & Idempotency Reconcile
workflows.intent: Inspect append-only WAL, detect DISPATCHED state prior to crash, probe external API, and reconcile without duplicating mutations.

reconcileTimeoutMs.description: Maximum latency wait for upstream provider response before declaring OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.

workflows.name: Context Compaction & Trajectory Thought Pruning
workflows.intent: Prune intermediate chain-of-thought traces, summarize conversation milestones into a CompactedEvent, and verify checkpoint manifests.

retainedTurnCount.description: Number of active recent events to preserve verbatim after compaction.

workflows.name: Byzantine Fault Detection & Rogue Agent Slashing
workflows.intent: Detect cryptographic signature equivocation, revoke agent mesh delegation, and slash Wilson confidence score.

slashPenaltyRatio.description: Proportion of Wilson confidence interval to deduct upon proven Byzantine infraction.

workflows.name: Continuous DID Key Rotation Chain
workflows.intent: Generate dual-signed rotation envelope linking old and new Ed25519 keys, verify continuous provenance, and update DID document.

cryptographicCurve.description: Elliptic curve algorithm for new key generation.

workflows.name: Onyxbox Micro-Sandbox Provisioning & Auto-Purge
workflows.intent: Spawn ephemeral micro-container with network lockdown, execute untrusted tool payload, and verify automated 15-minute purge sweep.

autoPurgeMinutes.description: Hard TTL before micro-sandbox container is forcefully destroyed.

workflows.name: Cross-Model Agentflex Plan Synthesis & Critique
workflows.intent: Gather parallel plan proposals from 3 frontier model families, execute pairwise critique matrices, and synthesize unified consensus plan.

critiqueRounds.description: Iterations of dialectical peer critique before synthesizing final plan.

workflows.name: Declarative Step Playbook & Gate Parking
workflows.intent: Compile playbook steps into content-addressed hash, step through automated agent tasks, and park execution safely at approval gates.

stopOnFirstError.description: Halt the entire playbook sequence immediately if any step returns non-zero error.

workflows.name: Postguard Prompt Injection & Jailbreak Firewall
workflows.intent: Inspect incoming prompt strings, detect prompt-injection token anomalies, block pre-model inference dispatch, and record audit evidence.

sensitivityLevel.description: Anomaly score threshold for dropping suspect prompt turns.

workflows.name: Dynamic DAG Scheduling & JoinNode Barrier
workflows.intent: Validate acyclic topology via 3-color DFS, schedule parallel worker branches, synchronize at JoinNode barrier, and verify deterministic topology hash.

workflows.name: Transitive Web of Trust & Peer BFS Federation
workflows.intent: Evaluate decentralized peer-to-peer transitive trust via Ed25519-signed endorsements, depth-bounded BFS traversal (max depth 3), and signature chain attestation.

maxBfsDepth.description: Maximum depth for transitive trust BFS path evaluation (RFC-0017 default 3, max 8).

requireDoubleSigning.description: Require both old and new keys to sign rotation links.
